300-6561572ic ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), by and among Laura Salman, having an address at 231 Beaumont Street, Brooklyn, New York 11235 ("Seller"), and Sheepshead Bay Road Owner, LLC, a limited liability company having its principal office c/o Avalon Bay Communities, Inc., 671 North Glebe Road, Arlington, Virginia 22203 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Seller is the owner of the land known as 1654 Sheepshead Bay Road, Brooklyn, New York 11235, designated as Block 7459, Lot 34 on the Tax Map of the City and State of New York (the “Seller's Land", together with the building and improvements thereon, the “Seller's Improvements"; the Seller's Land and Seller's Improvements herein being referred to collectively as the “Seller's Property"), and more particularly described on Schedule A annexed hereto. B.． Developer is the owner of land known as 1501 Voorhies Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11235, designated as Block 7459 Lot 67 on the Tax Map of the City and thereon or any future building and improvements thereon, collectively, the “Developer's Improvements"; the Developer's Land and Developer's Improvements herein being referred to collectively as the “Developer's Property"), and more particularly described on Schedule B annexed hereto. C. An affiliate of Developer is the owner of the land known as 1600 Sheepshead Bay Road, Brooklyn, New York 11235, designated as Block 7459 Lot 102 (the "Adjacent Land; together with the buildings and improvements thereon, the “Adjacent collectively as the “Adjacent Premises"), and as more particularly described on Schedule C annexed hereto. D. The Developer's Land and the Adjacent Land (and other lands) constitute a single zoning lot for the purpose of Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution and Developer intends to enlarge such zoning lot to include the Seller's Land (the “Combined Zoning Lot"). E. The Seller's Improvements contain less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use on the Seller's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer's Property and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined), and Seller is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity. The parties hereto (among others) have executed and delivered (i) a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the“Declaration") dated the date hereof,which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording*in the Kings County Office of the Register of The City of New York with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, and (i) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in ksimuiTaueosly #29068001_v4
